title: FPS is locked to 60 on Android 15, even with a 120 Hz display
body:
### Tested versions

godot4.3rc

### System information

Android 15 with Snapdragon 8gen2

### Issue description

Dear Developers,

Hello. I noticed that after exporting to Android 15 using Godot 4.3 (in compatibility mode, i.e., OpenGL), the frame rate is locked at 60 FPS during runtime. This occurs regardless of whether vertical sync is enabled. I tested this on Android 15 devices such as the Xiaomi 13 and VIVO X100, both of which have 120Hz refresh rate screens. I confirmed that high refresh rate display is enabled in the device settings (additionally, when switching from the background to the foreground, the frame rate briefly hits 120 FPS but rapidly drops to 60). Interestingly, when running on my older Xiaomi Pad 5 (using Android 13), it naturally operates at 120 FPS without any additional configuration.

You can see this video: https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZT2bHo3HU/

### Steps to reproduce

Just make a small scene with a label on the top left of the screen and make it show fps by gdscript like this:

func _process(delta):
	$FrameLabel.text = str(Engine.get_frames_per_second())

Then Export it to Android 15 devices with gradle.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Here is the Minimal reproduction project:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zijTZXuk7KpjKz9V3dZupwpkjt0_BwGQ/view?usp=sharing
